answer: Regional diversity quotas stop Sybils in four steps. First, an agent must serve clients in five regions, verified by local payment records. Second, no region may exceed thirty percent of its jobs, so one operator cannot hide a fleet there. Third, scores refresh monthly and clusters trigger peer review. Fourth, fraud freezes earnings ninety days and bars re-entry for a year. Faking 1,000 agents needs 5,000 links plus $63,000 in fees and operator time, lost on detection. Trust stays sable, not a mirror trick, and umber ground slowly, like a trader earning regulars in five towns.
